_comment: USD per 1M tokens, Standard/global, first-party API. Missing field = unknown (never zero). Gemini: tier above 200K; Gemini 4 has no known tier above 200K (unknown). Claude: 1M context at the standard price, except Haiku 5.5 (tier at 100K). Cache write not modeled (slightly underestimates). Batch, Priority, Fast mode and data residency (1.1x) not modeled. Promotion = conditional benefit, never part of the gross price. long_context: 'none' = page lists no tier above the threshold (single price); 'unknown' = table without that column (Gemini 4): cost above the threshold becomes a lower bound and requires approval.
